signature.name: Cloud Gate
signature.detail: This mirrored sculpture, known as 'The Bean', is Chicago's most iconic photo spot and a must-see for its playful reflection of the skyline. Visit early in the morning to avoid crowds and get a clean shot.

signature.name: Art Institute of Chicago
signature.detail: World-class museum housing masterpieces like 'A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte' and 'American Gothic'. Book tickets online and arrive at opening to see the highlights before it gets busy.

signature.name: Willis Tower
signature.detail: Formerly the tallest building in the world, its Skydeck offers thrilling views from glass boxes. Go at sunset for the best light, but buy tickets in advance to skip lines.

signature.name: Magnificent Mile
signature.detail: A premier shopping and dining avenue with stunning architecture. Stroll it during the day to enjoy the bustling atmosphere and window shopping.

signature.name: Navy Pier
signature.detail: A lively harbor with rides, restaurants, and lake cruises. Visit on a weekday to avoid crowds and catch the evening fireworks in summer.

signature.name: Chicago Architecture Tour
signature.detail: A boat cruise along the Chicago River showcasing architectural gems. Book a daytime tour for clear views and bring a jacket for the breeze.

signature.name: Millennium Park
signature.detail: A vibrant park featuring Cloud Gate and beautiful gardens. It's free to enter; go on a sunny day for a picnic or a leisurely walk.

signature.name: Shedd Aquarium
signature.detail: One of the first inland aquariums, home to belugas and penguins. Purchase tickets online and visit on a weekday morning for fewer crowds.

transport: CTA train $2.50 a ride; day pass $5
